title: 2005 HMMT February Team Round 1 Problem 1
statement: Prove that for any two types of dominoes, there exists a rectangle that can be tiled by dominoes of either type.

solutions.text:
Note that a type \((a, b)\) domino tiles a \(\max \{1,2 a\} \times 2 b\) rectangle (see diagram for \(a>0)\). Then both type \((a, b)\) and type \(\left(a^{\prime}, b^{\prime}\right)\) dominoes tile a ( \(\max \{1,2 a\}\). \(\left.\max \left\{1,2 a^{\prime}\right\}\right) \times\left(2 b \cdot 2 b^{\prime}\right)\) rectangle.
